name: D.O.M.
notes: 2 Michelin stars, Alex Atala. One of Brazil's most celebrated restaurants. Also: comunicacao@domrestaurante.com.br (press). Reservations at domrestaurante.com.br/reservas/

name: Maní
notes: 1 Michelin star, chef Helena Rizzo. Latin America's 50 Best 2024 #35. Also atendimentomanioca@manimanioca.com.br for groups 10+. R. Joaquim Antunes, 210.

name: Tuju
notes: 2 Michelin stars, chef Ivan Ralston. Latin America's 50 Best 2025 #8. Reservations via Tock. R. Frei Galvão, 135.

name: Nelita
notes: 1 Michelin star, chef Tássia Magalhães. Latin America's 50 Best 2025 #12. All-female kitchen. R. Ferreira de Araújo, 330, Pinheiros.

name: Metzi
notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand. Latin America's 50 Best 2024 #27. Chef Eduardo Nava Ortiz. R. João Moura, 861, Pinheiros.

name: Corrutela
notes: Sustainability-focused contemporary cuisine, Latin America's 50 Best Discovery. R. Medeiros de Albuquerque, 256, Vila Madalena.

name: Clandestina
notes: 1 Michelin star, chef Bel Coelho. Only open 1 week/month, 24 covers/night, tasting menu. R. Girassol, 833, Vila Madalena.

name: Kinoshita
notes: 1 Michelin star. Only Krug Ambassade in South America. WhatsApp: +55 11 95318-5978. R. Jacques Félix, 405, Vila Nova Conceição. Reservations via Tagme.

name: Koshô
notes: Contemporary Japanese, est. 2015. Rua Marcos Lopes, 121, Vila Nova Conceição.

name: By Koji
notes: Chef Koji Yokomizo. Fresh-fish-focused omakase. R. Escobar Ortiz, 730, Vila Nova Conceição. Opened 2023.

name: Osso
notes: Michelin Guide. Chef Renzo Garibaldi from Lima. Dry-aged meats, private room. R. Bandeira Paulista, 520, Itaim Bibi. Reservations via Tagme.

name: Barbacoa
notes: Est. 1990, iconic upscale Brazilian churrascaria. R. Dr. Renato Paes de Barros, 65, Itaim Bibi. Online reservations via Resy. WhatsApp: +55 11 3078-1126.

name: Atto Restaurante
notes: Chef Luiza Hoffmann. Historic mansion setting. WhatsApp: +55 11 94810-0000. R. Pais de Araújo, 138, Itaim Bibi.

name: Ohka
notes: Dinner-only Japanese cuisine. Est. institution in Itaim. R. Prof. Carlos de Carvalho, 105, Itaim Bibi.

name: Yū Restaurante
notes: Modern Japanese in Itaim. R. Jerônimo da Veiga, 121, Itaim Bibi. WhatsApp: +55 11 99445-6106.

name: JAM (Itaim)
notes: JAM = Japanese Food, Arts & Music. Two locations: Itaim (R. Lopes Neto, 308) and Jardins (R. Bela Cintra, 1929). Reservations via Tagme.

name: Sallvattore
notes: Est. 2005. Authentic Mediterranean-Italian. R. Salvador Cardoso, 131, Itaim Bibi. Reservations via WhatsApp.

name: Osaka (Nikkei)
notes: Peruvian nikkei chain from Lima. R. Amauri, 234, Itaim Bibi. 39K Instagram followers.

name: Freddy
notes: Est. 1935. Oldest French restaurant in SP. Heritage 'Selo de Valor Cultural'. R. Pedroso Alvarenga, 1170, Itaim Bibi. WhatsApp: +55 11 97450-9635.

name: Aizomê
notes: Chef Telma Shiraishi. Japanese-Brazilian fusion. WhatsApp: +55 11 97247-3862. Alameda Fernão Cardim, 39, Bela Vista (near Jardins).

name: Murakami
notes: Michelin Guide. Evening-only, reservation required. Alameda Lorena, 1186, Jardins. Dinner shifts at 7 PM and 9:30 PM.

name: Kiichi
notes: Est. 2007. Japanese rodízio in Jardins. Also has Vila Olímpia branch. Alameda Lorena, 138, Jardins.

name: Fasano
notes: Flagship Italian restaurant of Fasano group. R. Vitorio Fasano, 88, Jardins. Reservations via hotel front desk.

name: Goya Zushi
notes: Michelin Guide. Chef Uilian Goya. Omakase 10-15 courses. R. Artur Frazão, 37, Jardim Paulista. Reservations via GetIn.

name: Picchi
notes: 1 Michelin star since 2017, chef Pier Paolo Picchi. Italian family recipes + Brazilian ingredients. WhatsApp: +55 11 99448-9575. R. Oscar Freire, 533.

name: Pasquale Cantina
notes: Est. 2001. Chef Pasquale Nigro. Multiple award winner for best Italian in SP. R. Girassol, 66, Vila Madalena.

name: Tanuki Sushi
notes: 21+ years in Vila Madalena. Small and beloved neighborhood sushi. R. Jericó, 287, Vila Madalena.

name: Kubo Zushi
notes: 1 Michelin star. Chef Sergio Kubo. Edomae sushi. WhatsApp: +55 11 94388-8866. R. das Tabocas, 158, Vila Madalena.

name: La Nonna di Lucca
notes: Famous Spaghetti Al Formaggio in Grana Padano wheel. Est. institution. WhatsApp: +55 11 99163-9133. R. Gaivota, 689, Moema. Note: email is HR dept, best to call for reservations.

name: Al Mare
notes: 35 years serving premium seafood. Av. Pavão, 109, Moema. Reservations via GetIn app.

name: Bosco Restaurante
notes: EXAME Casual 2024 Top 100. Historic 1940s mansion with century-old jabuticaba trees. Chef Natalia Ebone. R. João Moura, 976, Pinheiros.

name: Cór Gastronomia
notes: Dry-aged meats and contemporary cuisine. Unique architectural setting. Praça São Marcos, 825, Alto de Pinheiros.
